description: This file is a shell library containing functions for common merge tool operations in a Git environment, including configuring tools, running merge or diff commands, listing available tools, and handling tool paths and configurations.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode allows diff or merge operations.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if a specified merge tool is available in the environment.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configured tools matching a specific section in git config.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays names of available tools based on condition and parameters.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Determines if the current mode is set to diff.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Determines if the current mode is set to merge.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Gets default GUI setting based on mode and environment.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Checks if GUI mode is enabled.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the merge tool, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies if the merge result is unchanged from the backup.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Checks if a tool is valid and executable.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Sets up a user-defined tool with commands for diff/merge.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Initializes tool-specific functions and configurations.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command to run a specific merge tool from git config.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Determines if a tool's exit code can be trusted.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Prepares the environment to run a specific merge tool.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Runs the configured merge or diff tool.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Executes the diff command for a given tool.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Executes the merge command and verifies success.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Lists potential merge tools based on environment.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information for available tools.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Attempts to auto-guess a suitable merge tool.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Gets the merge tool set via git config, or defaults.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Resolves the executable path for a merge tool.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Determines the merge tool to use, possibly guessing.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Finds Windows-specific command for a tool.
